readme: I build the machinery behind dependable work: business platforms, developer environments, and delivery automation designed to be clear, secure, recoverable, and useful long after the first release.
My current work spans business systems, governed delivery, and developer tooling.

paragraphs: I work on software that has to survive contact with real organizations: business systems, operational workflows, and the tools engineers use to build and maintain them.

My interests connect software architecture with writing and developer environments. I care about clear boundaries, recoverable workflows, evidence that can be checked, and systems that remain understandable after the original implementation context is gone.

Current work includes CE Systems, an internal operations platform for Casa Elida; CE Governed Delivery, an evidence-driven engineering-governance effort; and Metadata Reconciler, deterministic GitHub metadata operations.

Public work includes [j3w1zsh](https://github.com/j3w1/j3w1zsh), a portable, resumable Zsh workstation framework for Arch Linux, WSL, and Termux; [1688toCSV](https://github.com/j3w1/1688toCSV), a focused browser extension for practical order-data export; and [the source for this site](https://github.com/j3w1/j3w1.github.io).
